device_name: Tritanium TL Curved 3D TLIF Spacer 3D Printed Titanium
description: The Tritanium TL is a Curved interbody spacer for use in the TLIF procedure and is made from Styker patented additive 3D printing to create a high porous internal structure. The curved banana cage has an articulating inserter to make anterior disc space placement easier.
features: 3D printed titanium with high porous architecture with 55-65% porosity
